['Total Raffinerie Mitteldeutschland Gmb.company_description: TotalEnergies Raffinerie Mitteldeutschland GmbH operates a modern crude oil processing plant in Leuna, Germany, and offers a wide range of energy products including lubricants, LPG, heating oil, aviation and shipping fuels, bitumen, and special products for industry. The company is also involved in the installation and operation of high-power charge points for electric vehicles and the modernization of the POX methanol plant.

['Galeria Karstadt Kaufhof GmbH '].company_description: Galeria Karstadt Kaufhof GmbH operates as the second largest department store group in Europe, with 131 locations and 18,000 employees. The company was formed in 2018 with the merger of two of Germany's most historic department store chains, Galeria Kaufhof and Karstadt. The company has faced challenges during the COVID-19 pandemic and has announced plans to close a significant number of its stores.
